arguments.command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
p='src/thread.ts'
s=open(p).read()
def rep(a,b):
    global s
    assert s.count(a)==1,a
    s=s.replace(a,b)
rep('import { GitSync, isTurnBoundary } from "./storage/sync.ts";','import { GitSync, isTurnBoundary, liveRef } from "./storage/sync.ts";')
rep('''	const ref = threadRef(issueNumber);
	const worktree =''','''	const ref = threadRef(issueNumber);
	// The run works on local refs outside refs/pi/, where a fetch the agent runs can't move them (#46).
	const local = liveRef(ref);
	const worktree =''')
rep('''					ref: worktreeRef(issueNumber),''','''					ref: liveRef(worktreeRef(issueNumber)),
					name: worktreeRef(issueNumber),''')
rep('''		ref,
		companionRef: worktree?.ref,''','''		ref,
		localRef: local,
		companionRef: worktree === undefined ? undefined : worktreeRef(issueNumber),
		localCompanionRef: worktree?.ref,''')
rep('''		repo: cwd,
		ref,
		author:''','''		repo: cwd,
		ref: local,
		author:''')
rep('''await rootCommitTime(cwd, ref)''','''await rootCommitTime(cwd, local)''')
open(p,'w').write(s)

p='src/worktree.ts'
s=open(p).read()
rep('''	/** `refs/pi/worktrees/<n>`. */
	readonly ref: string;''','''	/** The local ref the snapshots are recorded on (`refs/pi-action/worktrees/<n>`, see `liveRef()`). */
	readonly ref: string;
	/** The ref's name on the remote, for the log (`refs/pi/worktrees/<n>`); default `ref`. */
	readonly name?: string | undefined;''')
rep('''on ${ref}${state.skipped''','''on ${this.options.name ?? ref}${state.skipped''')
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
sed -n 185,260p src/worktree.ts
